    Gaia 0.1.1 API

    Modules
    Module
    Description
    be.imgn.gaia.core
    Extensions to the JDK.
    be.imgn.gaia.core.testing
    Test helpers for code that uses be.imgn.gaia.core, such as a FakeTicker.
    be.imgn.gaia.memfs
    An in-memory file system, for the mem: URI scheme.
    be.imgn.gaia.platform
    A cross-platform API over the host the JVM runs on.
    be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing
    Fakes of the be.imgn.gaia.platform API, such as a FakePlatform.
    be.imgn.gaia.processing
    Helpers for writing annotation processors.
    be.imgn.gaia.processing.testing
    A harness that compiles in-memory sources through annotation processors, AssertJ assertions on the outcome, and a JUnit extension that gives tests the Elements and Types of a running compilation.
